takeaway: For the first time the radar measured growth itself, re-reading 45 repos a day apart: morluto/rea (+5,004), ai-job-search (+1,559) and dsh-purge (+1,342) gained most. The new leader is storytold/artcraft, an open AI art and video IDE, but rea's stated +201k-a-week does not hold up.

findings.heading: The radar measured its own growth for the first time
findings.text: 45 repos were re-read one day after first being seen. The largest one-day gains: morluto/rea +5,004, MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search +1,559, YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge +1,342, stablyai/orca +637, debpalash/VoiceStudio +623.

findings.heading: morluto/rea's stated growth does not hold up
findings.text: The trending page states +201,065 stars this week, but the radar measured +5,004 in the last day. The repo has 86.0k forks and only 1.2k watchers. It stays flagged and discounted.

findings.heading: A new leader: an open-source IDE for AI art and video
findings.text: storytold/artcraft gained 13,572 stars in 7 days, to 34,022. It wraps 62 image, video, 3D and music models. No launch event or backer was found; the cause is GitHub Trending exposure.

findings.heading: Agent security leads, but the commercial gap is narrower than it looks
findings.text: 80% of tracked security repos are in the top quartile. Runtime-guardrail vendors already exist and were bought (Lakera by Check Point). The open gap is auditing from inside coding agents.

findings.heading: Coding-agent companies are reaching $1B run-rates
findings.text: Cognition reported a $1B run-rate on Sep 25, up from $492M in May. Modal passed $1B on Oct 14. Both figures were read from search results, not opened at source.

findings.heading: Star counts of agent plugins are being gamed
findings.text: YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge gained 1,342 stars in a day with only 18 watchers for 10.0k stars, and its README asks for stars. The radar's anomaly rule cannot catch this yet.

caveats: Catch-up run: the scheduled run failed, so this one ran later in the day.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries, because no source page could be opened. Each needs a check at its cited URL.
Hugging Face, Hacker News, the GitHub API and npm could not be reached for a second day, so models, Spaces, launches and package downloads are missing.
Some company metrics mix definitions (weekly vs monthly users, gross vs net revenue). Deltas between them, such as ChatGPT revenue falling $20B in a day, are artefacts.
No forecast has matured yet; the first scorecard is expected around 2026-10-27.
